intent: Shared cinematic material language for Home, Ground, Life Map, Focus, Replay, Passport, and Status.

obsidian_glass.usage: Primary premium glass surfaces, chamber panels, and quiet reflective world layers.

smoked_metal.usage: Portal frames, chamber ribs, platform supports, and structural trim.

portal_energy.usage: Inner portal seams, transition thresholds, and destination gateway light.

floor_luminous_seam.usage: Walkable path guides, Ground descent traces, and spatial route lines.

star_dust.usage: Life Map particles, galaxy depth, memory-star haze, and quiet atmospheric detail.

memory_glow.usage: Memory nodes, Focus star flight, Replay film windows, and selected state aura.

privacy_shield.usage: Passport, consent, protected rooms, privacy boundaries, and secure layers.

gold_provenance.usage: Receipts, ownership seals, audit marks, launch proof, and trusted status accents.

soft_volumetric_haze.usage: Atmosphere layers, chamber depth, portal bloom, galaxy fog, and cinematic loading states.

runtimeNotes.threeJs: Map baseColor to color, emissiveColor to emissive, roughness and metalness to MeshStandardMaterial where applicable. Use opacity with transparent=true only for intended translucent materials.
runtimeNotes.performance: Use glowIntensity as a design token for bloom/postprocessing or shader strength, not as raw unbounded light intensity.
runtimeNotes.accessibility: Provide reduced-motion and reduced-bloom variants for comfort mode.
